**Advisory — design only; no files changed and no worker/provider call.**

At `bddec92` (after `0897ba2`), the smallest useful E2E proof is one disposable invocation of the real coordinator role, using the explicitly trusted **whole-role LunaHigh override**—not a config default. Let that coordinator decide whether and when to call a fixed custom-tool adapter. The adapter exposes only the existing `prepare`, `launch`, `read`, and `reconcile` CLIs; it must not sequence them automatically or provide generic shell, default tools, context discovery, extensions, or MCP.

**Minimum harness:** run against a preinitialized host Pi SDK singleton. Supply one fixed disposable job/grant, unique attempt ID, private runs store, and trusted pinned config. Permit exactly one actual coordinator and at most one canonical LunaHigh worker, with no retry or fallback. Before any provider call, enforce the parent-owned offline/precall gate. The worker brief pins the source checkout, exact job input and target-base revisions, config SHA, coordinator-skill SHA, and methodology `37a56ebc902e94f21fc10666f33fceac44946af7` as separate identities. Have the worker fix a real arithmetic regression and run the existing immutable/protected checks; parent verifies the resulting candidate and checks independently.

**Evidence:** record bounded event/tool metadata (operation, safe attempt ID, status, hashes, route/effort, check outcomes), never auth values, raw commands, or transcripts. Since lifecycle observation can expose captured stdout/stderr, the adapter should parse and retain only allowlisted result fields—not archive raw output. `read: unknown` blocks; terminal success is not acceptance. Keep the one-actor budget even after failure.

**Observed seams:** `pi-worker-task.mjs` already pins committed brief bytes and emits identity hashes; `worker-lifecycle.mjs` already provides the four CLI operations, atomic attempt creation, and observation. `.audit/coordinator-44-native-result.json` shows an actual LunaHigh attempt failed its boundary gate, so rerun only with a newly verified fixture and pre-call gate. Existing teardown evidence proves the isolated initiating Pi process exited before release; it does **not** prove main coordinator/chat session-ending behavior or an initiating-Pi `ESRCH` guarantee. Keep those conclusions separate.

No dispatcher, parser framework, daemon, new docs, dependencies, globals, or remote actions. Untracked operator files remain untouched.
